tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun bka' srung las mgon gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: las mgon bsnyen cing sgrub 'dod na: dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas mchog tu: stegs bu brtsegs shing dkyil 'khor bri: dbus su dur khrod ro ras la: khrag chen dag gis bris pa'i sku: gri snying dang ni nal bu'i snying: sngags byang bla rdo thun rdzas bsham: mda' dar nag po me long can: sha khrag gis brgyan gtor ma bsham: mchod pa spyan gzigs ci 'byor bkram: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags shing: bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod mchod byin brlab: rten rnams mgon po'i dkyil 'khor bsgom: spyan drangs mchod bstod tshul bzhin bya: ma hā kā la yab yum gyi: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ dang bhyo: so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba la: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phog: sngags ni byang sems rang bzhin can: yab yum zhal gsang brgyud pas bskor: sngon gyi dam bca' dran pa dang: bde ba chen po'i nyams 'bar nas: dngos grub thams cad stsol ba dang: phrin las thams cad 'grub par bsam: grub nas dngos grub bskul nas kyang: rten la bstim zhing bsngo ba bya: zhag bdun brtsams pas 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ma mgon sgrub pa'i phrin las ni: mdun du dur khrod chen po'i dbus: bhrūm̐ las thod mkhar gru gsum nang: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba la: padma nyi mar dgra bgegs steng: hūm̐ las sras mchog nag po'i sku: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ber nag gsol zhing dur khrod chas: gri gug dang ni thod khrag 'dzin: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog 'chib: de yi pang du re ma ti: me long dang ni phur pa 'dzin: g.yang gzhi re lde'i sham thabs sogs: ma mo rol pa'i chas kyis brgyan: thabs shes bde stong 'khril sbyor gyis: me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong du gsal: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la: rang 'dra'i yab yum rta zhon bzhi: drel zhon rnams kyang cha lugs rdzogs:

gza' klu bdud btsan pho nyar 'gyed: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: de las 'od 'phros spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐: 'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang: gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang: dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams nas: ma mgon lcam dral spyan 'dren gyis: ye shes mgon po gshegs su gsol: dam tshig mgon po gshegs su gsol: las kyi mgon po gshegs su gsol: dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol: dregs pa sde brgyad gshegs su gsol: shrī ma hā kā la kā li e ā ralli hrīng dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yis: dbang bskur rigs lngas dbu brgyan bsam: padma nyi ma'i gdan la gzhugs: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar: sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dbang po'i me tog tshil chen gsur: zhun chen mar me khrag mkhris dri: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling sgra: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: rakta sha chen lang ling bcas: bza' bca'i gtor ma bsam mi khyab: sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis: ma hā kā la 'khor bcas mchod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la kā li sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe nas shabda kā ma gu ṇa ma hā ta na gha ṇa pū dza ho: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las snying rje khros pa'i sku: gtum chen dus mtha'i mun ltar gtibs pa'i sku: srin po khros 'dra zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: sku gsum ye shes spyan ni nyi ltar 'bar: sma ra smin ma ral pa kham nag 'khrugs: thod skam rin chen lnga yis dbur brgyan cing: sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab: ltag na spyan gcig ma mo dbang du sdud: g.yas pas gri gug dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod: g.yon pas bhañdza dam nyams snying khrag 'thung: dar nag ber brtsegs gser rked mi lpags bcings: dmag rdzong chen po beng phur rked la btsugs: sag lh+wam yu ring gsol nas rol stabs kyis: bdud rta bcibs nas gling bzhi khyab par rgyug:

gar bskul sa ru mi ro rags su brtsegs: zlog pas mi bzlog sngags zlog mkhan gyi gshed: ma mo dregs pa'i tshogs kyi tshogs dpon mdzad: dpal mgon nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyo: de yi yum mchog srid pa'i rgyal mo ni: rma bya seng ge sbrul gyis dbu brgyan cing: dur khrod chas can re lde'i sham thabs gsol: snang srid rab gsal me long phur pa 'dzin: lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma zla ba shar: zhabs gnyis 'khril bas mkha' gsang yab la stob: khyod ni bdud kyi lcam la gshin rje'i yum: nad kyi bdag mo sman gyi gtso mo mdzad: dpal ldan lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bka' sdod nag po chen po lcam dral brgyad: yang 'khor gza' klu bdud btsan pho nyar 'gyed: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu stobs can: dam can srung mar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis: dam rdzas dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig: rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ 'di bzhes shig: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings: rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: mched lcam 'khor dang dkor nor skyong ba dang: rkyen dang bar chad thams cad zlog tu gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol: phrin las gsol zhing rten la gnyis med bstim: dpal mgon lcam dral mnyes shing phrin las 'grub: ༁ྃ: yang gcig man ngag bstan pa ni: ma mgon lcam dral sku gzugs rten: de yi steng du 'bru sna dang: sha khrag gtor ma brjid ldan bsham: byin gyis brlabs la mgon por bskyed: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: mgon po yab yum thugs rgyud bskul: ci bcol las rnams sgrub par bsam: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ yakṣa bai ta li hūm̐: sbrel zhing bzlas pas rtags rnams 'byung:

sa ma ya: dgra bo cham la 'beb pa'i phyir: dur khrod gnas su stegs bu'i steng: mgon po'i sku bshams de yi mdun: 'bru nag khrag chang dug gi gtor: zur gsum rtse mor srung 'khor dang: smad char ming byang gsad 'khor bcug: mgon po yab yum dregs par skyed: mdun du btson khang drag po'i nang: dgra bgegs bskyed cing yang yang bstim: gsod dmigs mgon po'i gzhung ltar bya: las 'grub gtor ma zor du 'phang: dgra bo phung thal brlag par 'gyur: sa ma ya: srung ba mgon po'i gur khang bsgom: rang ming rakṣa'i sngags mjug btags: zlog pa mgon po'i dmag dpung spro: bar chad bhyo zlog sham bu btags: gsad pa dgra bo mā ra ya: ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'phrul 'khor bya: las rnams thogs med myur du 'grub: sa ma ya: dam nyams bsgral phyir liṅga'i steng: lhung bzed kha sbub mkhar gsil dang: chos gos kyis bkab mdo sgrog cing: nyams pa bstan bshigs 'di zhes pas: bstan pa bshig pa 'di bzhin la: mgon po khyod kyis srog las mdzod: ces pa'i dmod bor 'gug gzhug bya: de yis dgra bo myur du brlag: sa ma ya: thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod dang: khyad par rlung nag 'tshubs klong nas: ma mgon lcam dral sku bzhengs shig: bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin: khyod ni bstan pa srung bar bskos: da ni bstan pa 'jig la nye: bstan pa'i dgra la las mdzod cig: yid la brnags pa myur du sgrol: mgon po las la chas pa'i tshe: zhal ni sprin nag 'khrugs pa 'dra: phyag na rtse gsum gri gug thogs: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog 'chib: nag po 'bum gyi jag pa 'gyed: bya nag 'bum ni klad na lding: khyi nag 'bum ni rol du khrid: pho nya gza' rgod king kang 'beb: klu bdud nag pos mdze nad thongs: btsan rgod dmar pos gri 'thab thongs: bdud kyi zhags pa nag po thobs: bhyo: yum chen srid pa'i rgyal mo ni:

'dre mo nag mo'i cha lugs can: phyag na rtse gsum nad rkyal bsnams: drel rta rkang gsum rlung gshog 'chib: khyod kyi sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga: mtshon cha'i dru bu dgra la phongs: nad kyi rkyal pa dgra la phyes: dkar nag sgril ba'i shwa la thobs: dgra bo gshin rje'i khrom la thobs: gsod pa'i las mdzad ma mo bdun: gsha' gri dmar po lag na thogs: rlung nag zhon nas dgra bo gsod: dmag rgyal bzhi dang sring mo bzhi: ma mo thams cad las la chos: srog la bsdos nas khyod bsgrubs pas: re ba'i don 'bras da res yin: bstan pa'i dgra bo ma bsgral na: khyod kyis zhal bzhes nyams par 'gyur: de bas dgra la rtags thongs shig: lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig: zhag dang za mar ma 'gor bar: srog rtsa chod la snying khrag thungs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes bskul gos brdab dmod mo bya: ma mgon las la chas nas su: dgra bo myur du gsod par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rin chen shing ngam rdza ma sogs: ri rab bang rim lnga pa yi: steng du thod mkhar gru gsum du: ma mgon sku dang sngags byang dang: gri snying srog gi 'khor lo dang: mtshal dang 'bras bu shing lo sogs: nal bu'i snying dang phyogs mtshams su: rta nag g.yag nag lug nag dang: khyi nag bya nag bya mo nag: snying dang bka' sdod sku gsung thugs: bang rim dregs pa sum cu yi: sku gzugs sngags byang rten rdzas bsham: byin rlabs ri rab chen po'i steng: thod mkhar so so'i nang dag tu: ma mgon dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bskyed: spyan drangs mchod bstod bzlas pa bya: rnga chen brdung zhing sha chen bdug: dar nag g.yab cing rkang gling 'bud: hūm̐: gson cig dgongs shig nag po che: sku ni char sprin 'khrugs pa 'dra: zhal gdangs ljags ni glog dmar 'khyug: mche ba zla tshes spu gri'i tshems: spyan ni nyi ma ltar 'bar zhing: smar smin dbu skra bskal pa'i me: ber chen bskal pa'i mun pa ltar: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar:

g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang gsol: beng chen rked btsug lha dmag 'gyed: sag ti'i lh+wam gsol rol stabs kyis: rdzu 'phrul rta nag rlung gshog 'chib: sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di la: ji srid bar du bzhugs nas kyang: sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod: gang 'dod thams cad dbang du sdus: 'khor dang dkor nor skyong ba dang: nyin gyi dus su bya ra dang: mtshan gyi dus su mel tshe mdzod: sdang ba'i dgra la rtags thongs shig: gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig: bstan pa'i dgra bo bsgral du gsol: bhyo: dpal ldan lha mo srid pa'i rgyal: sku ni mun pa lta bu'i mdog: ri rab chen po'i zom la gnas: lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char: phyag na me long sbrul zhags bsnams: rma bya'i thor tshugs ldems se ldem: seng ge sbrul gyis rna ba brgyan: mi lpags g.yang gzhi re lde gsol: rdzu 'phrul drel rta rkang gsum bcibs: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas: sku gsung thugs kyi sogs nas/ bsgral du gsol: bar/ hūm̐: bka' sdod lcam dral bcu drug dang: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yang: sku gsung thugs kyi sogs/ spro na bka' sdod dregs pa yi: ming dang cha lugs smros te 'bul: gal che de bzhin mdos kyang bya: hūm̐: dpal ldan ma hā kā la ni: ri rab chen po'i zom la brten: sku ni srid pa gsum dang mnyam: spyan nas bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: zhal nas bskal pa'i chu chen 'brub: shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub: snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug stong sgrog: phyag gnyis tsandan bing chen brten: bskal pa'i mun ltar ber chen gsol: lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin cing: lha min g.yul ngo zlog par byed: shākya thub pas dbang bskur nas:

bstan srung kun gyi gtso bor bsngags: ma hā kā la tshogs kyi bdag: dpal 'bar legs ldan nag po la: snang srid mdos kyi mchod pa 'bul: ye shes lnga yi nam mkha' dang: thabs shes rang bzhin mda' dang 'phang: sku gsung thugs kyi rgyang bu dang: bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang: snyan pa sgrog pa'i ba dan dang: sku glud rgyan dang ldan pa rnams: ma hā kā la'i tshogs la 'bul: bhyo: shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la: srung ma chen po mthu rtsal can: bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam: 'dod pa khams kyi bdag mo la: snang srid mdos kyi sogs/ gong bzhin phrin las gsol ba dang: 'khor gyi tshogs la 'bul bar bya: mi rta bya khyi khri 'bum 'bul: hūm̐: nga ni snang srid kun gyi rje: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon che: ma hā kā la mthu bo che: legs ldan nag po tshogs kyi bdag: pho rgyud mo rgyud kun 'dus pa'i: dpal mgon ma ning nag po la: mon pa mi nag khri dang 'bum: rta nag dar gyis brgyan pa 'bum: bya nag bye ba sa ya dang: khyi nag lcags kyi mche ba can: dgra bo gsod pa'i shan pa 'bum: sa gzhi bar snang gang bar 'bul: nag po 'bum gyi pho nya yis: bstan pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: dmag dpung g.yul ngo zlog tu gsol: bhyo: mkha' la dbang bsgyur re ma tī: mgon po kun gyi lcam gcig ma: dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo dang: de sogs 'khor rnams kun la 'bul: brtan bzhugs las la 'gyed pa 'am: dgos pa'i don dang sbyar te bya: lha srung rten la 'khor ba dang: dngos grub thams cad 'du bar 'gyur: bar chad zlog pa'i gdams pa mchog: khrag 'thung nag po bdag gis gdams: 1$0000230o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i zab gter gyi gsang ba yang dag pa'o// dge'o/// /
